strongest_angle: Examining literary crossovers between Sherlock Holmes and Dracula through academic analyses and pastiche novels from authors like Loren D. Estleman and Christian Klaver.

key_facts.fact: Loren D. Estleman wrote the novel Sherlock Holmes vs Dracula or the Adventure of the Sanguinary Count, analyzed in essays hosted on Diva Portal.
Author Christian Klaver featured Count Dracula arriving at Baker Street to seek Sherlock Holmes's help in his Classified Dossier series.
Daniel Cottom published an analysis of Sherlock Holmes Meets Dracula within the cultural world of the late nineteenth century via University of Pennsylvania Press.
Sherlockian.net documents Arthur Conan Doyle's original story The Sussex Vampire where Sherlock Holmes investigates a case involving suspected supernatural elements.
